# Check runs that must have concluded `success` on the exact commit a release tag points at (REVIEW R06).
# One GitHub Actions job name per line, exactly as the job's `name:` renders. release.yml fails closed when any of
# them is missing, still running, skipped, cancelled or failed. Keep this list in step with the workflows: a renamed
# job must be renamed here too, or every release tag fails (which is the safe direction).
